video_title: Back from vacation and bedtime is gone: what to do (1-6 yrs)
caption:
It was working and now it isn't: back from vacation and bedtime is gone.

Bedtime problems are common in young children (1-6 years), and a trip can scramble the routine.
Start with the same wake-up time every morning, weekdays and weekends.
Then repeat the same bedtime routine each night and say: "Same as always. I'm here."
